This book can be found in the bookcase of a player-owned house after The Eyes of Glouphrie.
They are created by using a damp cloth on regular adamant arrows to create unlit adamant fire arrows, which are then lit by using them on a fire.

sc: Air staves can be bought from Zaff's Superior Spellcasting in Varrock or from the Grand Exchange.
Players can obtain 30 free air and mind runes from Aubury of Varrock and Carwen Essencebinder in Burthorpe.
An anti-sun potion is an item obtained by killing Clawdia during The Beach events.
The arrowstorm drape is a cape dropped by troll shamans, which can be found in the Burthorpe Troll Cave, in the eastern-most cave.
The tier-40 starfury cape is also hybrid and has better stats, but it can only be obtained on a members world and is unavailable to Ironman accounts.
The augmented Malachi's Claw is a level 95 Ranged off-hand weapon created by using an augmentor on a Malachi's claw.
It is made by augmenting masterwork ranged body with an augmentor and 36 divine charges at an invention workbench.

Barbarian assault ticket - hard wave 2.x: The Barbarian assault ticket - hard wave 2 is an item that is obtained from Captain Cain or Commander Connad by requesting to change your current wave in hard-mode Barbarian Assault from wave two back to wave one, or attempting to enter the wave one lobby.

sc: Bloodpouncer is a legendary pet that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
It could originally be unlocked by redeeming 90-100 membership days, or red pre-paid game cards at any retailer.
A blue dragon egg is an egg that can be obtained as a drop from adult blue dragons.
Players can obtain it by taking a blue dragonhide (a drop from blue dragons) and 20 coins to a tanner, or 45 coins for the Canifis tanner, or by using the Make Leather spell at level 83 Magic.
Tanners can be found in Al Kharid, the Ranging Guild, Varrock, Taverley, Canifis, Prifddinas, Burthorpe, Wendlewick and the Crafting Guild.

tx: The boon only appears under the "Vibrant energy products" weave menu, not the lustrous menu. It can consume lustrous energy if available, although vibrant energy is prioritised.
sc: It is created by converting 1250 vibrant energy or 1250 lustrous energy, requiring 70 Divination and giving 15 experience.
Bright Inquisitor Outfit is a cosmetic override set that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
They can be made at a forge and anvil using 1 elder rune bar and elder rune armoured boots, requiring 800 progress to complete, granting a total of 1,000 Smithing experience.
The bronze idol head was a common reward from the Squeal of Fortune, but can only be obtained as a member.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 bronze bars, requiring 200 progress to complete, granting a total of 30 Smithing experience.
When dropped by a monster, it will be treated like tiny plated bronze salvage by the spring cleaner.

Cabbage ball.x: The cabbage ball is an item transformed from the large gnomeball from Treasure Hunter. It is obtained by kicking a large gnomeball 50 times.

u: Canopic jar with berries and ring
sc: It's made by adding dwellberries to an empty canopic jar.
The chaos relic (uncommon) is a relic obtainable from The Zamorakian Undercity.
The player uses this key to obtain the scrap of map from the chest by the Old man during the quest.

h: Via skilling, killing Clawdia, and the Cosmetic Item Shop
sc: A Clawdia wings token is an item that could first be obtained during the 2016 Summer Beach Party.
Clue scroll (master) is a scan clue obtained from master sealed clue scrolls.
Clue scroll (medium) is a map clue obtained from medium sealed clue scrolls.
A Columbarium ring is made by enchanting a topaz ring with the Lvl-3 Enchant spell.
The sunspear has an effect that provides a 20% chance of receiving loot similar to that given by shiny columbarium keys.
The completionist hood is a hood obtained from the museum guard when a player purchases a completionist cape.
A Constitution XP lamp is awarded when defeating the Earth Warrior Champion.
A Constitution XP lamp is awarded when defeating the Imp Champion.

r: Partial completion of Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Pirate Pete
sc: Cooked crab meat can be made by cooking crab meat which is dropped by crabs.
They are found on the floor in the north-west corner of the pillory area with the bongos, and should be used on the de-lore-ing device to fine-tune it before operating it once more.
Crunchy's scimitar is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 50 of the Yak to Basics event and was later available for a time from the Marketplace for 2,500 oddments.
The dagannoth scale is an item dropped by Dagannoth Supreme that can be used to unlock the miniature-boss pet Supreme hatchling.
It can be created by using an ice dye on the Dark Sliver of Leng.
It is made by using two soft clay on a potter's wheel, requiring 81 Crafting and giving 52 experience.
It could originally be unlocked by owning all pieces of the Fire warrior outfit, which could be won from Treasure Hunter.
It could later be unlocked by purchasing the Fire warrior outfit override pack from the Marketplace for 1,500 oddments.

Desert Wanderer outfit.x: Desert Wanderer outfit is a cosmetic override set unlocked as part of the Desert Wanderer Bundle.

sc: It was obtained from the Squeal of Fortune, skilling, or by killing monsters.

Diving Suit Mermaid Hunter Helmet.x: The Diving Suit Mermaid Hunter Helmet is a head slot cosmetic override that is part of the Diving Suit.

sc: A dragonstone necklace (formerly known as dragon necklace) is a necklace made by using a gold bar, a dragonstone, and a necklace mould on a furnace.

Eastern kimono (blue).x: The blue eastern kimono is part of the eastern outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

Elf-style trousers (red).x: The red elf-style trousers is part of the elven outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: The empty enchanted "vacuum" vial is a quest item given to the player by Wizard Myrtle during Curse of the Black Stone.
It is created by combining the broken compass found on the western beach of Anachronia with the compass arrow which can be obtained from Big Game Hunter.
It is made by ensouling a gorgonite bar at the Daemonheim ritual site with level 80 Necromancy, and can be used to make gorgonite guards and lanterns.
It is created by finding it during The Firemaker's Curse, after discovering Firemaking journal compilation (1) earlier in the quest.

sc: The fresh crab shell is an occasional drop from crabs, and can be crafted into a crab helmet with a chisel with 15 Crafting, but there is a chance that the player will fail and result in a broken crab shell instead.
Frosty Cerberus Armour is a cosmetic override outfit that can be unlocked by redeeming tokens available on Treasure Hunter during the Cerberus Frost promotion.
Gardening boots are an item worn on the boots slot, and can be obtained by killing a farmer or by buying them from Head Farmer Jones.
The ghost essence is dropped by various ghosts.
The goblin kitchen key is found in a chest in the Observatory Dungeon, and is used to open the kitchen gate in that same dungeon.

Golden cracker.x: The golden cracker is an Item which celebrates Jagex winning the Golden Joystick Award for UK Developer of the Year. If the hammer is misplaced somehow, one can obtain a replacement golden cracker (not the hammer itself) from Diango once again in order to obtain a new hammer. When someone pulls a cracker on another player, the second will receive a message s

sc: These teleport scrolls can be obtained as a reward from a treasure trail.
Guthix page 2 is an item which can be added to the damaged Guthix book received from Jossik after the Horror from the Deep quest.
It can be found as a reward from all difficulties of Treasure Trails or by burning vyre corpses in the columbarium.
The Havensilver off-hand longsword +2 is a tier 60 off-hand melee weapon made from havensilver.
It can be obtained by attaching the master completionist hood to the master completionist cape.
If lost, it can be made again after buying a new cape and hood from the Museum guard on the top floor of Varrock Museum for 5,000,000 coins, and using them on the Ornate grave in Falador Park.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 iron bars and an iron dagger, requiring 320 progress to complete, granting a total of 80 Smithing experience.
They could be found in the troughs behind the anvil inside the workshop.
It can be obtained from the Guardian's Gift, with other items, by selecting the Warrior's Wish for 10% charge.
In July of 2022, it was added to Treasure Hunter as a very rare prize for the Academy of Heroes promotion.

Kalphite Sentinel Helm.x: The Kalphite Sentinel Helm is a head slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Kalphite Sentinel outfit.

sc: They can be made by using 3 mithril ore and 12 coal on the smelter.

New Varrock Cultist Hood.x: The New Varrock Cultist Hood is a head slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the New Varrock Cultist outfit from Aris' Reward Shop after completing Dimension of Disaster.

Nocturnal Greatsword.x: The Nocturnal Greatsword is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that can be obtained by purchasing the Nocturnal Weapon Bundle.

sc: The pirate hook (left) is a reward from the Brimhaven Agility Arena.
Project Woodpecker can be obtained when excavating at various excavation hotspots at the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site.
The Prophecy tablet is obtained by giving the Unfinished astral rune rewarded from Glorious Memories to Baba Yaga on Lunar Isle.

If the tablet is lost but you have previously given the unfinished astral rune to Baba Yaga, you do not need to re-obtain the rune from Chieftain Brundt again; Baba Yaga will return the tablet to you.

sc: The rainbow pet token is a Treasure Hunter reward from the Rainbow's End promotion.
It can be redeemed to unlock Joseph, destroying the token in the process after a confirmation prompt.
The Relic helm of Saradomin is obtained after completing all the jobs given to you from the follower of Saradomin, Julienne.

Relicym's balm flask.x: A Relicym's balm flask is a potion flask containing six doses of Relicym's balm. It is created by using Relicym's balm potions on a potion flask. Only the six-dose flask is tradeable on the Grand Exchange, but lower-dose versions can still be traded directly with other players.

Replica GWD (Pernix) Chaps.x: The Replica GWD (Pernix) Chaps are a legs slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Replica GWD (Pernix) outfit.

sc: The ring can be made by casting the Lvl-6 Enchant spell (or using the Lvl-6 enchant spell) on an onyx ring, which requires level 87 Magic.
An onyx ring can be made at level 72 Crafting by combining a cut onyx and a gold bar at a furnace while carrying a ring mould or having a ring mould stored in your tool belt.
Shirt (female, green) is obtained from the Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza Distraction and Diversion.
Upon receiving a piece from the ringmaster, it becomes available as a cosmetic override in the Customisation interface.
There are six types of shirts which may be awarded to players.
It can be obtained from Dodgy Derek for 10 pilfer points.
It is crafted from a starbloom hat + 2 and starbloom cloth using the tailoring process, granting a total of 21,120 Crafting experience.
The starfury hood is a hood made by adding a starborn diamond to a starfire hood.
The stasis javelin is a main hand ranged weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 37 of the Kerapac Track while having access to premier rewards.
The Swords of Light pack is a cosmetic override pack that can be bought for 3 silver pennies after completing Dimension of Disaster.
The Voice of the Elders is a possible book reward given by the light creatures after completing a lap on the Hefin Agility Course in Prifddinas.
Subsequent chapters are received after every interval of 20 laps.
A Thieving lamp is given as an additional reward for completing Missing, Presumed Death, by talking to the statue of Death in the Empyrean Citadel.
It is given by Thorvar Crittersmash, along with Thorvar's bucket.
It was made by using 4 equa leaves with a half baked batta, then baking it and adding pineapple chunks and orange chunks in any order.
Unstable protean protein is a Treasure Hunter reward from the Cerberus Rush promotion.
The experience given by each unstable protean protein scales according to the player's Cooking level at certain intervals.
The Wallace Halo appearance token is a unlock token awarded to Fresh Start Accounts that unlock the Wallace pet during the Fresh Start Worlds gamemode.
The token can be traded, once, directly to another player (it is not available on the Grand Exchange).

Werewolf mask (grey, male).x: The grey werewolf mask is part of the werewolf costume item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: The dagger is a reward for completing the Priest in Peril quest.
With the release of River of Blood, this weapon now only be "destroyed"; no longer can multiple daggers be obtained by using the drop trick.
A XP lamp (tier 1) is an item obtained during the Broken Home quest.
It is the first lamp obtained in the quest, located in a chest found in the room with the book puzzle.
It cannot be obtained on the first playthrough, and requires at least level 10 in each skill except for the skills released after Divination: Invention, Archaeology, and Necromancy.
They can be obtained from a easy reward casket as part of the Treasure Trails Distraction and Diversion.

Zarosian Mark.x: Zarosian Mark is a neck slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Zaros pack.

sc: It can be found at the very end of Zemouregal's Base in the wilderness, in the map room.
It can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It can be created at level 57 Smithing from four zephyrium bars.
